name: setup-repository-guidelines
description: Repository-family routing, installer integration, and clean-deployment rules for the linked Linux setup repositories.

interface.shortDescription: Route and deploy changes across the Linux setup repository family.
interface.longDescription: Discovers repository-family membership from installation_scripts, routes each concern to its owner, requires component-based clean-install integration, and verifies deployment without disrupting the desktop session.
defaultPrompt: Apply the setup repository guidelines to this task.
